categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server framing logic in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Hardens the HTTP server against request framing ambiguities by strictly rejecting unsupported or multiple Transfer-Encoding headers in compliance with RFC 9112 section 6.3. LoadBody previously checked only the first header and fell back to Content-Length or reading an empty body on invalid codings, creating potential parsing desynchronization vulnerabilities.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The changes to unit tests, functional tests, and the fuzz harness merely pin and validate the HTTP server framing changes.
categories.rationale: Does not change general test framework machinery; test updates follow directly from the HTTP server fix.
